claims.text: The hotel is in close proximity to the Palace of Parliament and People's Salvation Cathedral.

findings.quote: is in close proximity to the stately Palace of Parliament and People’s Salvation Cathedral

claims.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Bucharest's Old Town.

findings.quote: within walking distance of Old Town, with its diversity of architecture

claims.text: The hotel sits on Dealul Spirii hill and was built in the 1980s as part of the same urban plan as the Parliament Palace.

findings.quote: the hotel is located on "Dealul Spirii" hill in Bucharest. It was built in the 80's as part of the same urbanism plan as one of the satellite buildings, adjoining Parliament Palace

findings.quote: luxury lobby with warm colors accented by natural daylight, marvelous marble staircases, and imposing cupolas

findings.quote: Locally hand-crafted items such as ceramic plates with traditional Romanian motifs and multifaceted mirrors

findings.quote: a fully equipped kitchen, a stylish dining room, and a spacious, round-shaped bedroom

findings.quote: experience the Executive Lounge located on the hotel’s top floor

claims.text: The daylit swimming pool has a green garden backdrop and is open year-round.

findings.quote: The day lighted swimming pool is a year-round destination with lush greenery garden as an iconic backdrop.

claims.text: JW Steakhouse serves USDA Black Angus beef with wine and bourbon.
